purpose: Inventory every economically or operationally meaningful boundary where the same waterline method can recover operator attention or capture frontier residue.
laws: Compare accepted outcomes, not vendor benchmark scores.
Runtime identity, tools, context, effort, and transport are part of the treatment.
Errors do not buy capability escalation.
Subjective work uses blinded or mixed acceptance and never masquerades as deterministic.
Open-weight winners enter mechanistic capture; closed winners enter behavioral capture.
Wall-clock latency is secondary unless the task contract says otherwise.
